meta.title: SciX literature assistant
meta.description: Search ADS/SciX astronomy literature, analyze citation networks, read arXiv full text as text only (never PDF), and export BibTeX/AASTeX/RIS citations deterministically, using your own free ADS API token.

ui.tokenHint: Create a free personal token on the ADS/SciX settings page and paste it here. The token is stored only in the local credential store, never in plugin config, and is never shown again after saving.
ui.notWritable: The current credential source is read-only; saving and removing are unavailable here.
ui.verifyUnavailable: Verify service unavailable: make sure the plugin is enabled and its Host core is loaded.
